description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the JsonFieldSelector interface, representing a JSON field selector with a set of JSON pointers and associated string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelector
classes.description: An immutable class implementing JsonFieldSelector, encapsulating a set of JsonPointer objects and a string representation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonFieldSelector with no JSON pointers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonFieldSelector from given JSON pointers, with optional string representation.

methods.name: getPointers
methods.description: Returns the set of JSON pointers.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of JSON pointers.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no JSON pointers.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JSON pointers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on pointers and string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the JSON field selector.
